title: Update default aesthetics to ggplot2 4.0.0 `from_theme()` defaults
Save plot with innate dimensions
description:
This PR aims to fix #187.

Briefly, it adds a new function `save_plot()` that has `width = NULL` and `height = NULL` that default to innate plot dimensions. If such dimension is 'free' because there is no fixed size, it will default to `width/height = NA`.

title: Tag strips
description:
Fixes #149
``` r
devtools::load_all("~/packages/ggh4x/")
#> ℹ Loading ggh4x
#> Loading required package: ggplot2

ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap2(~ class, strip = "tag")
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/jPNKguc.png)<!-- -->

title: Independent placement of labels in `coord_axes_inside()`
description:
This PR aims to fix #167.

``` r
devtools::load_all("~/packages/ggh4x/")
#> ℹ Loading ggh4x
#> Loading required package: ggplot2

dat <- expand.grid(
  id = letters[1:3],
  time = 1:50 * 2
) |> cbind(y = rnorm(150))

ggplot(dat, aes(x = time, y = y)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(id)) +
  coord_axes_inside(labels_inside = "x") +
  theme_classic()
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/E2EQsEM.png)<!-- -->

<sup>Created on 2024-11-16 with [reprex v2.1.1](https://reprex.tidyverse.org)</sup>

title: Remove extra parenthesis
description:
Hi,

Thanks for the package, it is very useful.

When reading the documentation of `stat_theodensity`, I saw some extra parentheses in the last paragraph of the "Details" section.
It looks like these extra parentheses were introduced by the conversion to roxygen md. This PR removes them.
